english.title: Furnish false notification to housing authority on change of ownership or occupation of land
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in purported compliance with an obligation under section 247 of the Housing Act 1985, knowingly or recklessly furnished a notification to the local housing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), that was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY FALSEHOOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 249(1)(c) of the Housing Act 1985.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
